0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Clippers host the Sacramento Kings, and the Clippers are currently without Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), while the Kings are without Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-109 win over Sacramento on April 5, 2026, in Sacramento. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Clippers a 65% chance to win.
